title: Not getting Temp Basals as a Nightscout Follower
symptom: As a Nightscout follower, all data is received except basal patterns/temp basals, despite having 'Show Basal TBR' checked in Graph Settings. A user reports that basal rate adjustments don't show while BG, carbs, and boluses display correctly.
evidence_quote: Xdrip+ displays BG data, carb entries, and boluses correctly, however basal rate adjustments don't show.
